test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

An __unsullied__ safety record swelled pride in Concorde's technical achievement as the years passed.
solution: The correct answer is **"Tarnished."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The meaning of the word **"unsullied"** is not spoiled or made impure. (ख़राब या अशुद्ध नहीं किया गया) • **Example:** *This is a sensitive area which may guarantee that the stream of justice runs clear and **unsullied**__.* • The meaning of **"tarnished"** is made to seem less good or respected. (कम अच्छा या कम सम्मानित प्रतीत होना) __ • **Example: ***The company was starting to look a little **tarnished**__.* • The Antonym of **"unsullied"** is **"tarnished,"** meaning something that is no longer pure or perfect. • So, the correct answer is **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us see the meanings of other options:​ • **Undefiled: **not defiled; pure. (अपवित्र नहीं; शुद्ध) • **Impeccable: **without any mistakes or faults; perfect. (निर्दोष, त्रुटिहीन; परिपूर्ण) • **Perfect: **completely good; without faults or weaknesses. (पूर्णतः अच्‍छा, परिपूर्ण; दोषरहित) 1bf:T5a9, The correct answer is **"requires a lot."**
